chunks: And by this chain of narrators, from Muhammad ibn Uthman, he said: Narrated to us Ahmad, he said: Narrated to us Al-Muqaddami from Asim ibn Umar ibn Ali ibn Miqdam, Abu Yunus, he said: Narrated to me my father from Fitr ibn Khalifa from Abu Khalid Al-Walibi, he said: Narrated to us Jabir ibn Samra, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) say:
This religion will remain victorious; those who oppose it will not be able to harm it, until twelve Caliphs arise, all of whom are from Quraish.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the number of Caliphs from Quraish?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, this hadith from Jaber ibn Samura serves as a foundational proof for the number and Qurayshi lineage of the Twelve Imams, bridging Shia and Sunni traditions. It emphasizes the enduring triumph of Islam ('Din') against detractors until the establishment of these twelve leaders, reinforcing the concept of divine continuity in guidance.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 96 - It is narrated from the same chains of narrators from Muhammad bin Uthman that: Narrated to us Ahmad that: Narrated to us Muqaddami from Asim [bin Umar] bin Ali bin Miqdam Abu Yunus that: Narrated to me my father about the origin of Caliph from Abi Khalid Walibi that: Narrated to us Jabir bin Samra that: I heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say:
This religion would remain victorious and will not be harmed by those who intend to cause harm to it till the time that twelve Caliphs, all of whom would be from Quraish, rise up [for Imamate].
